anomalies: 12 of this map's pins are red strawberries carrying the pack's own pin names (e.g. "Mirror Temple A - Room a-00x Strawberry"), not the wiki's berry numbers. Which pin is which numbered berry cannot be established from the sources — that join was tested and rejected in the extract-data pass — so these pins track "did I sweep this room", while the numbered berries are tracked by the chapter strawberry table and the route steps.

notes: Deck slot 4 (mapPins, Checkpoint Map), scoped to location celeste:mirror-temple-a-start. Composition approved by Pierre 2026-07-30.

Pins come from src-tracker-maps' pin records for pack map 5_a_0. Coordinates are the pack's pixel positions divided by the image's own dimensions (3728x1711), rounded to 4 decimal places, so they survive any rendered size. Every pin was checked to fall inside the image bounds.
Image is the location's mapImage, already committed to guides/celeste/images/ under Git LFS by the spine pass — no new asset was downloaded.
Pin item IDs reuse the data layer's own record IDs as their last segment, which are minted from chapter/side/room and are unique within a map, so a re-run reproduces them.
No flagged pins. Every pin is a direct reading of the pack's coordinate data.
